raw_need: Proceed with incorporating cross-project retrospective feedback.
validated_need: QIF needs standalone pre-implementation review and negative acceptance guidance so users can block mistaken quality hypotheses before implementation, not only validate structure after implementation.
decision_summary: Validated as a docs-only v0.3.1 candidate. The chosen path adds standalone QIF guidance and Discovery Layer pattern extensions; runtime schemas, UI, external integrations, release/tagging, and AOF-specific enforcement are out of scope.

validation_questions_answered.question: What failure should QIF prevent earlier?
validation_questions_answered.answer: Solution-biased work, missing negative acceptance, data-boundary confusion, and concept-comprehension failure that can pass structural validation.

validation_questions_answered.question: What must stay out of scope?
validation_questions_answered.answer: Runtime schema implementation, UI, external integrations, release/tagging, and making QIF depend on AOF.

hidden_assumptions: Post-implementation structural verification was assumed sufficient to catch product assumption mistakes.
evidence_gaps: No multi-project pilot yet proves these pre-implementation review prompts reduce rework.
